integrity: Proof-based, with illustrative exact symbolic tests. No assertion of independent mathematical validation.
scientific_limitations: Applies to smooth relatively minimal semistable complex Jacobian elliptic surfaces with chi>=3, Picard number two and reduced discriminant. The singular locus is classified as reduced support; the Jacobian-scheme structure, origin and discriminant-plane degeneration types remain unclassified. The explicit Cox-ring presentation is independently available in arxiv:2611.24570 (first public after the November 15, 2026 anchor), and is not claimed as original.
title: Two singular strata and varying simple-elliptic transverse types in Cox spaces of Jacobian elliptic surfaces
